alternatives.name: Automatic type narrowing from isinstance patterns
alternatives.description: Have type checkers infer type guards automatically from isinstance() and similar patterns without explicit annotations.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Already done for isinstance/issubclass, but custom functions with complex logic can't be auto-inferred. TypeGuard fills the gap for user-defined narrowing.

alternatives.name: TypeGuard narrows in both branches
alternatives.description: If TypeGuard returns True, narrow to the guarded type; if False, narrow to the complement.
alternatives.reason_rejected: The negative case is not always safe. A function might return False for reasons unrelated to type. This was later revisited in PEP 742 (TypeIs) with stricter semantics.
